2026-09-27.name: Long run - 11 easy + 3 steady
2026-09-27.why: Last long run with a race-specific finish. The easy part must stay under 151 - your recent long runs drifted to 155-159, which turns them into medium-hard days.
steps: 11 km easy, HR cap 151. If HR passes 151, slow down - do not hold pace.
3 km steady at 6:05-6:15/km, HR 158-165.
Walk 3 min, stretch calves and hips.

2026-09-28.name: Strength B - glutes and core
2026-09-28.why: Moderate. Hip thrust, side plank, dead bug, single-leg bridge. Stop 2 reps short of failure.

2026-09-29.name: Easy 8 km + 4 strides
2026-09-29.why: Easy means Z2. Finish with 4 x 20 s relaxed strides to keep turnover.
steps: 7.5 km easy, HR 136-151
4 x 20 s strides at about 5:20/km, walk 40 s between

2026-09-30.name: Easy 5 km
2026-09-30.why: Recovery run. Short, very easy, cadence 170+.

2026-10-01.name: Strength A - light
2026-10-01.why: Light lower-body stability only. Friday is the key session of the week.

2026-10-02.name: Key session 1 - 3 x 2 km threshold
2026-10-02.why: Threshold is the limiter for a sub-58 10K. Program it as a Garmin structured workout so each rep is its own lap - km splits hide rep pace.
steps: 2 km warm-up easy, then 4 x 20 s strides
3 x 2 km at 6:00-6:10/km (treadmill 9.8-10.0 km/h), 2 min easy jog between
1.5 km cool-down
Pass: all 3 reps on pace with rep 3 averaging HR 168 or lower

2026-10-04.name: Long run - 14 km easy
2026-10-04.why: Pure aerobic long run. No fast finish this week - Friday carries the intensity.
steps: 14 km easy, HR cap 151 the whole way
If outdoors, start before 6:00 to beat the heat

2026-10-05.name: Strength B - short
2026-10-05.why: Half the usual sets. No soreness allowed this close to racing.

2026-10-06.name: Easy 7 km + 4 strides
2026-10-06.why: Steady easy run with strides at the end.
steps: 6.5 km easy, HR 136-151
4 x 20 s strides, walk 40 s between

2026-10-07.name: Easy 5 km
2026-10-07.why: Very easy. Legs should feel fresher by the end of this week.

2026-10-08.name: Mobility only
2026-10-08.why: 8-10 min piriformis, hip flexor and calf mobility. No weights.

2026-10-09.name: Sharpener - 4 x 4 min threshold effort (HR-led)
2026-10-09.why: Run by heart rate, not pace. Your Oct 2 threshold blocks hit HR 160-163 at 6:19-6:28/km, so 5:40-5:50 is not realistic yet. Touch race effort without piling on fatigue.
steps: 2 km easy warm-up (7:10 or slower)
4 x 4 min at threshold effort, HR 160-168 (cap 168), whatever pace that gives - expect about 6:20-6:35/km
2 min easy jog between reps
1.5 km easy cool-down + optional 4 x 20 s strides
Heavy legs? Stop after 3 reps. HR above 168 before the end of a rep: ease off

2026-10-11.name: Easy 10 km + strides
2026-10-11.why: Last longer run. Volume drops from here, intensity stays.
steps: 9.5 km easy
4 x 20 s strides

2026-10-13.name: Sharpener - 3 x 1 km at race pace
2026-10-13.why: Keeps race pace familiar without adding fatigue.
steps: 2 km easy
3 x 1 km at 5:40-5:45/km, 2 min jog between
1 km easy

2026-10-16.name: Shakeout 3 km + 4 x 200 m
2026-10-16.why: Short and sharp. Wake the legs up, do not tire them.
steps: 3 km easy
4 x 200 m at 5:15-5:25/km, full walk recovery
